about_the_game:
Explore, delve and conquer the boundless wilds of Faercana! A retro throwback to classic ARPGs, Myth & Magery invites you to switch off and sink into long sessions of slime-splattering, dungeon-diving and wand-waving as you seek to uncover the mysteries of the Chitin!

Side-quest forever!

❌Rescue the princess and prevent the apocalypse?

✔️Help Farmer Bob find his lost sheep!

Sound familiar? With endless procedural content and no "main quest" looming over our chosen hero, you can go side-questing guilt-free!

Delve, loot, slay, repeat!

The subterranean labyrinths of the ancients have become home to many horrors, but treasures await to be claimed by the bold...

Abracadabra!

Become a master of the arcane arts with in-depth, systems-driven spell- and wand-crafting.

Prepare for battle, in style!

Ancient relics, monster hides, enchanted gemstones - craft and tailor your gear for the challenges that await, and look cool doing it!

Features

  • Endless procedural landscapes, dungeons and quests

  • Gear that actually appears on your character sprite

  • Craft bespoke wands, spells, potions, food, clothes, trinkets, arms and armour

  • Top-down action combat

  • Infinite gameplay
